story.soThat: I can save experiment settings for reproducibility
story.tasks: - Implement get_config() method on Environment class with dict return type - Collect environment configuration parameters (episode_length, observation_radius, n_gradient_samples, step_size, bounds) - Collect function configuration via function.get_config() if available - Return configuration copy (not reference to internals) - Ensure JSON serializability of all config values - Add comprehensive NumPy-style docstring with examples - Implement GaussianTranslation.get_config() to support function configuration - Add unit tests for get_config() (returns dict, contains required keys, values correct, JSON-serializable, returns copy) - Integration tests with function configuration - Validate configuration completeness enables environment reconstruction

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
**AC1:** get_config() returns dict containing: episode_length, observation_radius, n_gradient_samples, step_size, function_params, bounds
**AC2:** function_params includes function-specific configuration (velocity, sigma, amplitude, mean_start, bounds, seed from GaussianTranslation)
**AC3:** get_config() returns copy of configuration (not reference to internals) - modifications don't affect environment
**AC4:** Configuration dict is JSON-serializable for saving experiments (all values are int/float/str/bool/list/dict/None)
**AC5:** Method completes in < 1ms (simple dict construction, no heavy operations)

python.package: NumPy for float64 types in configuration

story-context.constraints: - get_config() must return NEW dict each time (not stored as instance attribute) - Returned dict must be independent copy - modifications don't affect environment - All values must be JSON-serializable (int, float, str, bool, list, dict, None) - Convert NumPy types to Python types if needed (np.float64 -> float) - Tuples are JSON-serializable, so bounds tuple is okay - function_params may be empty dict {} if function doesn't have get_config() - Check hasattr(self.function, 'get_config') before calling - Handle missing get_config() gracefully (use empty dict, don't raise exception) - Include ALL constructor parameters in config dict for complete reproducibility - NumPy-style docstrings with comprehensive documentation - Type hint: -> dict on method signature - Performance requirement: < 1ms (simple dict construction) - Follow copy semantics pattern from get_history() (Story 2.5) - GaussianTranslation.get_config() should return all constructor parameters - Function get_config() is NOT abstractmethod - optional for Function2D subclasses

tests.standards: Testing standards from Architecture and existing tests: - Use pytest framework with fixtures from conftest.py - Test classes organized by functionality (e.g., TestConfigPersistence) - Test naming: test__ - NumPy-style docstrings on test methods - Edge case coverage: missing function.get_config(), JSON serialization, copy semantics - Performance tests use timeit for < 1ms validation - All tests must pass before story completion - Test coverage target: >95% for new get_config() methods
tests.locations: tests/test_environment.py - Add new TestConfigPersistence class tests/test_function.py - Add tests for GaussianTranslation.get_config() tests/conftest.py - Use existing fixtures
tests.ideas:
**Unit Tests for Environment.get_config():** 1. test_get_config_returns_dict - Verify return type is dict 2. test_get_config_contains_required_keys - Verify all 6 keys present (episode_length, observation_radius, n_gradient_samples, step_size, function_params, bounds) 3. test_get_config_values_correct - Verify values match environment settings 4. test_get_config_returns_copy - Verify returned dict is copy (modify returned dict, check environment not affected) 5. test_get_config_multiple_calls_same_values - Verify multiple calls return equivalent dicts
**JSON Serialization Tests:** 6. test_get_config_json_serializable - Verify json.dumps(env.get_config()) succeeds 7. test_get_config_json_round_trip - Verify json.loads(json.dumps(config)) preserves values
**Performance Tests:** 8. test_get_config_performance - Verify completes in < 1ms using timeit
**Function Configuration Tests:** 9. test_get_config_function_params_included - Verify function_params in config 10. test_get_config_with_gaussian - Verify function_params contains velocity, sigma, amplitude, etc. 11. test_get_config_without_function_get_config - Mock function without get_config(), verify function_params is empty dict
**Unit Tests for GaussianTranslation.get_config():** 12. test_gaussian_get_config_returns_dict - Verify returns dict 13. test_gaussian_get_config_contains_parameters - Verify mean_start, velocity, sigma, amplitude, bounds, seed 14. test_gaussian_get_config_values_correct - Verify values match constructor params 15. test_gaussian_get_config_json_serializable - Verify JSON serialization works
Map to ACs: - AC1 (dict structure): Tests 1, 2, 3 - AC2 (function_params): Tests 9, 10, 12, 13, 14 - AC3 (copy semantics): Tests 4, 5 - AC4 (JSON serializable): Tests 6, 7, 15 - AC5 (performance): Test 8
